# netcup_clouddns_revisions (Data Source)

The revisions of a domain on CloudDNS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_clouddns_revisions" "all" {
  domain_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) Id of the domain.

### Read-Only

- `revisions` (Attributes List) Revisions of the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--revisions))

<a id="nestedatt--revisions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `revisions`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `identifier` (String) Identifier of the revision.
- `modified_at` (String) Time of the last change.
- `serial` (Number) Serial of the revision, if it has one.
- `state` (String) State of the revision.
